transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

I guess… I haven’t really been myself. I don’t do the things I used to—hiking, coaching, guitar. I don’t call people back much. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing I should get up and do something, but I can’t seem to start.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. I just… feel kind of flat, I guess. Hard to explain.
Did anything significant happen in your life around the time this started?
Yeah… I mean, around when I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce. That was about… a year and a couple months ago. Things have kind of been coming apart since then.
Have you felt this flat or unmotivated most days for two years or more?
No… not two years. More like since I moved into that smaller place after the divorce. About a year and… two months, I think. Since then things have just kind of unraveled.
Do you feel these changes started because of the divorce?
I guess… it lines up with that. After the divorce, when I moved into the smaller rental, that’s when things started unraveling. About a year and two months ago.
Since the divorce, have these problems felt mainly like a reaction to that divorce?
I don’t know. I mean… the timing fits, but I can’t say it was just a reaction to the divorce. It’s hard to sort out.
Before the divorce, had you ever gone through another period like this?
Not really… not like this. It’s mostly been since I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce. About a year and a couple months.
After the divorce was finalized, did these symptoms continue for more than six months?
Yeah… more than six months. It’s been going on since I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce, so… about a year and two months now.
Have you been feeling anxious a lot of the time?
I don’t know… anxious? Maybe sometimes. I haven’t really been keeping track of it.
Most days lately, have you been feeling sad or depressed?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say depressed exactly. Some days I’m just… not right. But I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Lately, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah… I guess I have. I don’t really hike anymore, or play guitar. I stopped coaching too. Mostly I just sit around at the rental sometimes, knowing I should do things, and I just… don’t.
Have you been feeling sad or low most days?
I’m not sure. I mean… some days I feel off, kind of flat, but I don’t really know if I’d call it sad most days.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying?
I don’t know… not really worrying, I guess. I think about things, but I wouldn’t say I spend a lot of time on it.
During the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless nearly every day?
I don’t know… nearly every day sounds like a lot. I’ve felt kind of low or empty some days, but I’m not sure I’d call it depressed.
Lately, have you been feeling tense or on edge a lot of the time?
I don’t know… tense sometimes, maybe. I wouldn’t say I’m on edge a lot of the time.
Before this past year, had you ever had another period lasting at least two weeks when you lost interest in things and felt this same kind of low or flat?

Yeah… I think so. It’s been going on longer than this year. I just… stopped doing things. Hiking, coaching, guitar. I don’t call people back much. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing I should do stuff, and I can’t really get started.
Before the past year, did you ever have a separate period of at least two weeks when you lost interest in things like this?

Yeah… I mean, it wasn’t just this past year. I kind of stopped being me before that too. Hiking, coaching, guitar… calling people back. Some days I’d just sit there in the rental for hours, knowing I should do something, and I just… couldn’t get started.
Before the divorce, did you have a separate period of at least two weeks when you lost interest in things the way you have now?

Yeah… before that too. I mostly just didn’t feel like myself anymore. I’d stopped hiking, coaching, playing guitar… even calling people back. Some days I’d sit in that little rental for hours, knowing I had things to do, and I just couldn’t start.
Before the divorce, was there a separate period of at least two weeks when you felt down or depressed most days?
I… I’m not really sure. I remember being kind of shut down, but “depressed most days” before the divorce… I don’t know if I’d call it that.
Before the divorce, was there ever a time when you lost interest in things like hiking or guitar for at least two weeks?

Yeah. I think so. I’d already stopped doing most of that… hiking, guitar, coaching. I just didn’t have it in me. Even calling people back felt like too much. Some days I’d sit there for hours knowing I needed to do something and just… wouldn’t.
